At Genmab, we are dedicated to building extra[not]ordinary® futures, together, by developing antibody products and groundbreaking, knock-your-socks-off KYSO antibody medicines® that change lives and the future of cancer treatment and serious diseases. We strive to create, champion and maintain a global workplace where individuals’ unique contributions are valued and drive innovative solutions to meet the needs of our patients, care partners, families and employees.

Our people are compassionate, candid, and purposeful, and our business is innovative and rooted in science. We believe that being proudly authentic and determined to be our best is essential to fulfilling our purpose. Yes, our work is incredibly serious and impactful, but we have big ambitions, bring a ton of care to pursuing them, and have a lot of fun while doing so.

Does this inspire you and feel like a fit? Then we would love to have you join us!

**The Role

**Genmab is looking for a Senior Operational Project Manager to join the Early-Stage CMC Project Management Department in Copenhagen.

Technical Operations is responsible for the development and manufacture of Genmab's antibody therapeutics supporting preclinical, clinical, and commercial programs. As part of Technical Operations, the Early-Stage CMC Project Management department drives CMC development programs from Discovery through Clinical Proof of Concept (Phase I/II), working closely with cross-functional experts and external partners.

As a Senior Operational CMC Project Manager, you will play a central role in translating CMC strategy into operational execution for development programs. You will be responsible for planning, coordinating, and driving day-to-day CMC activities while ensuring alignment across internal functions, external manufacturing partners, and project governance.

You will collaborate with specialists across Process Development, Analytical Development, Manufacturing, Product Characterization, Pharmaceutical Development, Regulatory Affairs, Quality, Supply Chain, and other Technical Operations functions to successfully advance Genmab's pipeline.

You will become part of a highly collaborative team of experienced CMC Project Managers within Early-Stage CMC Project Management and report to the Team Lead, Early-Stage CMC Project Management.

**Responsibilities

**Your responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

• Drive the operational execution of integrated CMC development plans from Discovery through IND/CTA and early clinical development (Phase I/II).

• Develop, maintain, and execute integrated CMC project plans, including timelines, milestones, budgets, risks, deliverables, and resource planning.

• Coordinate day-to-day CMC activities across multiple technical disciplines and ensure effective collaboration between internal stakeholders and external partners.

• Manage operational interactions with Contract Manufacturing Organizations (CMOs), Contract Development and Manufacturing Organizations (CDMOs), testing laboratories, and other external vendors.

• Monitor project progress, identify risks and issues proactively, facilitate mitigation plans, and ensure timely escalation when appropriate.

• Facilitate robust cross-functional communication and provide clear project status updates to project teams and governance forums.

• Coordinate preparation and review of CMC documentation supporting global regulatory submissions, including INDs, CTAs, and other health authority interactions.

• Coordinate and follow up on quality-related activities, including deviations, investigations, changes, CAPAs, and other quality events affecting project execution.

• Support project budget management, forecasting, governance activities, and overall project execution.

• Ensure project activities are conducted in compliance with Genmab's Quality Management System and applicable regulatory requirements.

• Contribute to continuous improvement by identifying opportunities to strengthen project management processes, tools, and ways of working within Early-Stage CMC Project Management.

**Requirements

**To succeed in this role, you bring a strong combination of scientific insight, project management expertise, and the ability to lead complex cross-functional collaborations.

**You Have

**

• A Master's degree in Life Sciences, Pharmaceutical Sciences, Biotechnology, Chemical Engineering, or another relevant scientific discipline. A PhD or project management certification is considered an advantage.

• Approximately 8–10 years or more of relevant experience within CMC, biologics development, Technical Operations, or pharmaceutical development in the biotechnology or pharmaceutical industry.

• Demonstrated experience leading complex CMC development activities supporting biologics from early development through IND/CTA and Phase I/II clinical development.

• Strong project management experience, including planning, scheduling, budgeting, risk management, stakeholder management, and governance.

• Solid understanding of biologics process development, analytical development, GMP manufacturing, and CMC regulatory requirements.

• Experience working successfully with external manufacturing partners (CMOs/CDMOs) and outsourced development activities.

• Experience supporting regulatory CMC submissions and coordinating cross-functional deliverables.

• Strong communication, collaboration, and problem-solving skills.

• Fluency in spoken and written English.

**The Following Experience Is Considered An Advantage

**

• Development and manufacturing of antibody-drug conjugates (ADCs), or chemical engineering/API technology would be an asset

• Technology transfer between manufacturing sites or external partners.

• Experience working in an international matrix organization.

• Experience contributing to continuous improvement initiatives and implementation of project management tools or processes.

**We Are Looking For Someone Who

**

• Is an excellent collaborator and builds trusted relationships across functions and with external partners.

• Thrives in a dynamic environment while managing multiple priorities simultaneously.

• Takes ownership, demonstrates accountability, and proactively drives activities to completion.

• Has a structured, analytical, and solution-oriented approach to complex challenges.

• Communicates effectively with stakeholders at all organizational levels.

• Demonstrates sound judgment and maintains a strong quality mindset.

• Is curious, open-minded, and continuously seeks opportunities to improve processes and ways of working.

• Is motivated by delivering high-quality results that contribute to the success of Genmab and, ultimately, better outcomes for patients.

The proposed gross annual/hourly base salary range for this position, in the primary location, based on a full time schedule is:

DKK644.640,00---966.960,00

The final salary offer will depend on several factors, including your skills, qualifications, and experience.

In addition to base salary, this position is eligible for additional forms of compensation, such as discretionary bonuses and long-term incentives.

**Benefits

**When you join Genmab, you become a part of a culture that supports your physical, financial, social, and emotional well-being. Our benefits include, but are not limited to:

• Pension

• Health insurance and wellness benefits

• Paid time off

• Employee support programs

Further details on eligibility for compensation and benefits based on the role will be provided during the recruitment process.

**About Genmab

**Genmab is an international biotechnology company with a core purpose to improve the lives of patients through innovative and differentiated antibody therapeutics. For 25 years, its hard-working, innovative and collaborative team has invented next-generation antibody technology platforms and harnessed translational, quantitative and data sciences, resulting in a proprietary pipeline including bispecific T-cell engagers, antibody-drug conjugates, next-generation immune checkpoint modulators and effector function-enhanced antibodies. By 2030, Genmab’s vision is to transform the lives of people with cancer and other serious diseases with Knock-Your-Socks-Off (KYSO®) antibody medicines.

Established in 1999, Genmab is headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark with international presence across North America, Europe and Asia Pacific. For more information, please visit Genmab.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

**Job Description

**_Are you ready to shape the future of banking? Then join us at the forefront of technological innovation, harnessing the power of Generative AI to revolutionize internal processes within the Risk and Compliance organization. Your journey into the future of banking starts here!

_Danske Bank is seeking a Generative AI Engineer (Full-Stack Developer) with a keen interest in Generative AI to join our dynamic and innovative Generative AI squads within the Risk and Compliance Tribe.

The Risk and Compliance Tribe has a unique blend of business experts and IT specialists working together in agile teams. In our organization, teams are self-managed, entrusted to make key decisions, and crucial in driving end-to-end product and service delivery. Step into a world of collaboration, empowerment, and innovation, where you are not just part of the process, you are shaping it.

**Shape the culture and ways of working

**Our squad operates across borders, and you will be working alongside other Generative AI engineers and Business Analysts. As it has not been established for long, you will have a unique opportunity to shape our culture and ways of working within the squad, leaving your mark on our innovative endeavors.

In the words from Linnea Stigholt, one of the product owners of the GenAI squads, “_As a Generative AI Engineer in our squad, you will implement and work with rapidly evolving AI technology to help shape the future of banking. Your contributions will transform how we work in Risk and Compliance by enabling smarter, faster, and more efficient processes. Through these efforts, you will empower our colleagues and turn cutting-edge technology into real business impact.

_In this role, you will:

• Design, develop, integrate, and operate AI solutions used by our business users.

• Architect optimal ways to integrate GenAI into various existing and new products.

• Choose appropriate technical frameworks and optimization techniques for generative AI approaches, e.g., RAG.

• Work with prompt engineering, pre & post model invocation processing.

You will also optimize model usage cost, while you interpret and visualize model outputs for internal stakeholders, explaining complex AI concepts in simple terms. You will stay abreast of emerging AI trends and technologies, supporting the adoption of relevant innovations – while you also maintain high code quality and contribute to best practices in our AI development process.

**What we are looking for:

**We are looking for you with experience working with AI in Python: frameworks for LLM use like Langchain, Haystack 2.0, or Hugging Face. You have an extensive understanding of building enterprise solutions, primarily in Python – that you know how to integrate well into existing applications, services and enterprise architecture and then you also bring:

• Degree in computer science, AI, machine learning or a related field

• Professional experience delivering AI/ML solutions in Python

• Strong understanding of NLP, LLMs and transformer architectures, including practical experience designing and implementing RAG solutions using frameworks such as LangChain, Haystack 2.0 or Hugging Face

• Experience with React (TypeScript) Solid understanding of software engineering fundamentals and design patterns

• Experience with Git and CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure as code, preferably Terraform

• Experience with Docker and Kubernetes

• Experience with AWS and/or Azure

• Exceptional communication skills and fluency in English

**Nice to have

**

• Experience with Elasticsearch, OpenSearch, Azure AI Search or similar

• Hands-on experience with TensorFlow or PyTorch

• Experience with .NET/C#

**Location and eligibility

**

• Based in Copenhagen

• Requires a valid Danish work permit

**How To Apply

**We review applications on a rolling basis and encourage you to apply early. Submit your CV and a brief cover letter via the Danske Bank careers site. If you have any questions, contact Aleksandar Milacic, Chapter Lead, at amila@danskebank.dk.

We look forward to receiving your application.

At Siteimprove, we are the leader in agentic content intelligence. Siteimprove.ai is a unified platform that brings together accessibility, analytics, SEO/AEO, and content strategy into a single, continuous flow. Our AI agents work alongside marketing and digital teams — not instead of them — helping to create high-performing, accessible content that's easy to discover by both humans and AI.

As Senior Engineering Manager for Content Platform, you own the systems that acquire and ingest the content our entire product line reasons about. Our enterprise customers bring thousands of sites each, re-crawled continuously. Every accessibility finding, analytics number, and SEO recommendation begins as content one of your systems fetched, parsed, and stored.

You will lead two Copenhagen engineering teams, each with its own Technical Leader role held by a Principal Engineer. The two carry different hard problems. One sustains crawl throughput so that cost tracks value rather than volume. The other builds the shared foundations the rest of Siteimprove works through, so product lines reach content through common contracts rather than each solving it their own way. You represent this group's engineering in a trio with Product and UX. Pillar strategy is set with Seattle, nine hours behind you, and you are the leader on the ground who turns it into local decisions rather than waiting on it.

Your teams set the ceiling on what the rest of Siteimprove can build. Your goals follow from that — ingestion reliable enough that customers trust it, efficient enough that cost tracks value rather than volume, capable enough to feed our agentic products, and ready for the compliance bar our public sector customers require. You will use AI to build the platform that powers our AI products and stay close enough to the code to argue a design on its merits.

What we will be doing

• 
Decision Authority in Copenhagen: You are the decision-maker on the ground. Resolve in Copenhagen hours what would otherwise wait overnight. As engineering's voice in the group's trio, bring the constraints Product and UX have no way to see into scope conversations early enough to change them. Your director sets goals with you and discusses how you and the group are tracking against them.

• 
Platform Ownership: Own Content Platform's ingestion surface as a running business — availability, throughput, cost, and delivery predictability. Modernization is how you improve those numbers, not a separate program you report on. Our move to EKS is part of it. You decide which debt gets paid down and when and keep that trade-off in front of the trio.

• 
Architectural Direction: Own the constraints and the cross-team contracts your Technical Leaders design within: scheduling the crawl workload so cost tracks value rather than volume, moving ingestion onto event-driven services, and defining how the rest of Siteimprove consumes what we ingest. You will hold that direction with your senior engineers, because authority here is earned in design review.

• 
Delivery Under Pressure: Hold the delivery line when priorities move. Work arrives from outside the team continuously, and you will sequence so committed work reaches completion rather than stalling half-built. Align directly with peer engineering leaders and close the gaps at functions you depend on but don't manage.

• 
Measurable Impact: Define the KPIs these systems are judged by and hold your teams to them. You will prove the impact of what you prioritize in throughput, cost, and reliability rather than asserting it, and you will stop work that moves none of them.

• 
Growing Your Engineers: Own performance, career development, and compensation decisions for the group. Hand the Tech Vision and System Design for major initiatives to the engineers closest to the systems, and review rather than drive them.

• 
AI-Native Delivery: Use AI for engineering throughput, not just for product features. You will model the practice yourself: interpreting legacy code paths nobody documented, generating test coverage around behavior before you change it, and shortening the distance between a design decision and a working replacement

• 
Travel may be required; a valid passport is required

• 
Perform other duties as assigned

What we will require of you

• 
Ownership at Distance: A group whose outcomes you owned while the people setting direction sat elsewhere. We want evidence of decisions you made rather than escalated, because waiting would have cost more than being wrong. This role also asks for a standing weekly overlap in your late afternoon, when the Seattle day begins, so that the conversation with your director is a working one.

• 
Systems Depth: 7+ years in backend engineering, with real depth in distributed systems, high-throughput data ingestion, or crawling at scale. Comfort establishing how an undocumented system behaves before changing it, and the instinct to reach for AI to do that quickly.

• 
Leadership Through Leaders: 10+ years managing engineers, including senior technical leaders whose designs you reviewed rather than produced, and whose scope you expanded rather than absorbed.

• 
Architectural Judgment: A track record of moving established services onto cloud-native infrastructure and of designing interfaces other teams build on. What matters is having lived with both long enough to know which decisions held and which leaked.

Work Environment

• 
This is a hybrid role based in our Copenhagen office, with the opportunity to work from both the office and home. Our working language is English.

• 
Travel may be required up to 5% of the time.

• 
You will work across a nine-hour spread with product and engineering leadership in Seattle, and with peer teams in other Siteimprove locations. Your late afternoon overlaps the start of the Seattle day, and the role expects you to keep a weekly window there for goal-setting and progress discussions with leadership.

Millions of people wear Pandora to say something about themselves. Behind that sit two of the biggest levers on the company's results: a marketing investment among the largest in the industry, and the profitability of the jewellery itself.

You will build and run its engine keeping the Product and Marketing finance team connected to the financial heartbeat of the company: one planning calendar, one reporting standard, cost control across worldwide envelopes, and an automation toolchain that makes reporting produce itself. You are shaping how this team runs, and the role grows as the toolchain does. As we build the team capabilities, we continue delivering results every quarter, budget every autumn, and the value optimization discipline that funds our growth.

This is a role for someone who is a pace setter, taking real pride in a rhythm that builds credibility, and who wants to modernize how the work gets done.

**What You Will Do

**

• Own the Product and Marketing financial planning calendar end to end: budget and long-range planning milestones, forecast cycles, month-end and performance review inputs, orchestrating and collaborating so that every corporate deadline is met reliably and consistently.

• Own the reporting catalogue with clear service levels, and build the automation toolchain that produces the recurring suite, retiring manual production as you go.

• Run the functional line into our Global Business Services team: process catalogue, quality, capacity, one blueprint.

• Run cost control for the CMO, CPO and Global Office envelopes as a trusted, independent service.

• Front the team's interface to FP&A and the CFO office, reconciling to one set of definitions.

**What Is Needed To Succeed

**

• 7-10 years in financial planning, reporting or control; you have run a planning calendar or close process end to end.

• Experience building or running a shared-services or offshore interface, with the catalogue and quality rhythm to show for it.

• At least one recurring reporting process you automated, with the manual version retired, and genuine energy for doing it again at scale.

• The independence to hold deadlines, definitions and spend hygiene, including with colleagues more senior than you.

**Who You Are

**

• A self-starter: you see the missing process and build it before anyone asks.

• You develop and defend your own point of view: the calendar and the definitions are yours, and you can say no and make it stick, respectfully.

• You believe finance is a strategic copilot to the business, and control done well, an essential guardrail to earn investors' and consumers' trust.

• You can have difficult conversations respectfully, and colleagues trust you more because of them.

• Consumer-centric at heart: you keep the numbers connected to the people who wear the jewellery.

• People-first and collaborator: you make a shared-services team feel like one team, across sites and time zones.

Reporting into the Sr Director, Global Product & Marketing Finance, you will be the backbone of a small, senior team with a mandate from the top of the company, and you contribute by making excellent work systematic.

**Global Career Band 4B - Manager.

Hybrid Working Flexibility – 3 days in office per week

Location Copenhagen; Global scope.

English is our working language; Danish is not required.

Lead the team. Grow the business. Shape what comes next.

Are you ready to lead commercial growth across a diverse and important healthcare customer segment? This is a visible leadership role where strategy, customer insight and an engaged sales team come together with real ownership of commercial performance and the future direction of the business.

At Mediq Denmark, you will lead a team of 8 sales professionals supporting GP’s, specialist clinics and private hospitals. You will work closely with the Sales Director to turn market insight into action, strengthen customer partnerships and identify the opportunities that can move the segment forward.

This is a role for a leader who enjoys being close to the market. One day you may be shaping the sales strategy or challenging a business case; the next, joining a strategic customer discussion, coaching a colleague or turning a new idea into a practical growth plan.

Your impact

You will set the direction for the segment and translate ambition into profitable, sustainable growth. With ownership of the sales budget, forecast and commercial performance, you will keep customer value, market opportunities and team development firmly in focus.

• Develop and execute the sales strategy for GP’s, specialist clinics and private hospitals, supported by clear segmentation, targeting and account plans.

• Strengthen relationships across the customer landscape, from individual practices to strategic private hospital accounts, and take an active role in key negotiations and customer meetings.

• Use customer, market and competitor insight to identify growth opportunities, shape go-to-market plans and guide pricing and commercial decisions.

• Lead, coach and develop eight sales professionals, creating clear priorities, accountability and the confidence to perform at their best.

• Connect Sales with Category, Product Management and Sourcing to align the assortment, supplier strategy and commercial priorities around a strong customer experience.

What you bring

We are looking for a commercially curious and customer-focused sales leader who sees the bigger picture, acts with pace and brings people with them. You are comfortable moving between strategic business development and hands-on sales leadership, and you know when to explore the detail and when to step back and set direction.

• At least five years of documented experience in a comparable commercial and leadership role, including leading, coaching and developing sales professionals.

• A strong track record in sales execution, performance management and working with sales processes at both operational and strategic level.

• Strong commercial and analytical judgement, including the ability to develop and assess business cases and make sound pricing and growth decisions.

• Confident negotiation, presentation and stakeholder-management skills, supported by a structured and pragmatic approach to projects and processes.

• High energy, clear ownership and the ability to prioritise in a fast-paced and complex environment.

• Fluency in Danish and English. Experience from MedTech or the healthcare sector is an advantage.

Why join Mediq?

You will join a role where sales leadership is close to the action and your decisions will be visible. You will have the opportunity to influence commercial direction, build stronger customer partnerships and develop a team that can take this customer segment into its next chapter.

Our values - Customer Drive, Champion Spirit and Caring Heart - guide how we work, with a constant focus on creating value for patients.

Ready to lead the next stage of growth?

Bring your commercial leadership, customer focus and energy to Mediq. Help us strengthen the business, develop our people and build what comes next for customers across Denmark.

Location: Copenhagen Denmark.

Interested?

Submit your application through CareersatMediq.com or contact Artjoms.Bikovskis@Mediq.com, Talent Acquisition Partner Nordics and Baltics. We review every application with care and look forward to learning what you could bring to the future of Mediq Denmark.

We will be reviewing applications and interviewing candidates on a rolling basis as suitable candidates are identified. For this reason, we encourage you to submit your application as soon as possible.

About Mediq

Mediq is a leading European healthcare company with a 125-year legacy, operating in 14 countries with over 3,000 employees. Guided by our vision to enable sustainable healthcare, we focus on improving care outcomes and affordability through innovative products, services and solutions. Partnering with healthcare professionals across hospitals, clinics and home care, we help ensure patients receive the care they need to live independently, securely and feel more human.

At Mediq, we offer jobs that change lives. Join us.

Are you a people-focused leader who thrives on guiding teams toward shared goals? We’re looking for a supervisor who can inspire and develop a team while ensuring effective collaboration and results. • Maintain correct use of production planning software/hardware

• Continuous motivation and leadership development

• Managing and adjusting own behaviors to work effectively in the light of new information, changing situations, different environments, and flexibility

Competencies

• You thrive in an organization in continuous development

• You work with ease across different cultures

• You have solid experience of people management in a manufacturing environment e.g. in a chemical or with mechanical processes

• Good understanding and experience with Six-sigma and 5S

• Confident user of Microsoft Office and general good IT skills

An exciting and complex role in a global renewable energy company, with opportunities for professional and personal growth. You will help shape a critical area within Vestas and be part of an international, collaborative team.

**Job Description

**_Start your analyst career in investment management with our Manager Selection Team, where you will work with leading global asset managers and develop expertise across diverse asset classes. You will be part of a collaborative environment that offers significant learning opportunities and career progression. This role provides the foundation for building specialised knowledge in investment strategy and portfolio management.

_But first, who are we at Danske Bank?   Danske Bank, the largest bank in Denmark, serves a diverse range of customers from individuals and businesses to large institutional clients. At Danske Bank, we create an environment where creativity and strategic thinking are central to all our activities.

LC&I business unit supports Danske Banks’ most sophisticated customers across the Nordics with their financing and transaction needs. Our experts across areas such as Corporate Finance, Markets, Transaction banking, Asset Management and Investor Services – are highly skilled and engage with our customers on some of the most complex transactions in the Nordics.

**What You Will Be Doing

**Join the Manager Selection Team at Danske Bank Asset Management. The team is responsible for identifying, selecting and monitoring asset managers and investment funds used across Danske Bank's investment platform. You will collaborate with portfolio managers and analysts to deliver multi-asset portfolio solutions. Working closely with internal teams and external partners, you will contribute to strategic decisions that shape our investment products and client outcomes.

• Conduct quantitative and qualitative analyses of portfolio management teams and investment strategies

• Support manager searches, due diligence reviews and investment recommendation processes on internal and external opportunities

• Monitor performance, risk and key investment characteristics across various asset classes and investment products

• Contribute to the design and management of asset class specific investment strategies

• Collaborate with portfolio managers and analysts on multi-asset solutions

**About You

**

• Academic background in investment analysis, finance, economics, or related field

• Analytical mindset with structured approach to problem-solving

• Strong collaborative skills and ability to work with diverse stakeholders

• Interest in financial markets and investment management

• Clear communication skills for internal and external interactions

It would be beneficial if you have some exposure to financial analysis or investment concepts, though we welcome candidates who bring diverse perspectives to learn and develop in this area.

**What We Offer You

**Join our First Year Analyst programme, which includes dedicated sessions and social events to ease your transition into our culture and operations. You will build valuable connections across the organisation while developing both personally and professionally. Furthermore, we provide substantial learning opportunities where you will acquire specialised knowledge in investment strategy, asset allocation, and manager selection.

You will work in our Copenhagen office with a hybrid model of 3 to 4 days per week to support collaboration and knowledge sharing. As Manager Selection is a strategic focus area, you will gradually take on more responsibility as the business develops and grows.

**Are you ready for the next step?

**We would love to hear from candidates who are ready to develop their career in investment management. Please reach out to Torben Badsberg Overgaard, Head of Manager Selection, at toov@danskebank.dk or Carla Carlotta Zoe Steuer, Senior Portfolio Manager with any questions.

We review applications on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

We're looking forward to exploring the possibilities with you! Starting a career at Danske Bank means joining a collaborative environment where you can engage actively from day one. As a full-time employee, you will be part of our Young Minds community, designed to help you grow personally and professionally through development sessions and social events with your peers. If you are looking for a rewarding and interesting opportunity, apply now and become part of our team! #YP

**About Us

**Danske Bank is a Nordic bank with bridges to the world around us. For 150 years, we have supported people and businesses in releasing their potential. A career with us is an opportunity to join a community of 22,000 colleagues in a culture where we are committed to Teaming Up, Owning It and Being Open. Together, we are on a journey to transform Danske Bank into a better bank. For our customers, our employees and the societies around us.
